description: Agent preflight round 3: read the terms of a service your agent is about to start paying for, from the paying side, before it commits. Input text, fields (price, price_changes, auto_renewal, liability_cap, indemnity, termination, data_use) or both, and an optional exposure (the amount the service can move or charge). The signed report restates each term plainly and flags the one-sided and missing ones: a price that can change with no notice, renewal with no way to cancel, a liability cap below the amount the service can move, liability excluded, one-way indemnity, no termination path for you, termination at will by the provider and broad data use. To verify what a counterparty’s published terms say, use wever_terms-evidence-check. POST /api/service-terms-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.

inputSchema.description: Send the text, the fields or both.

exposure.description: Optional: the most the service can move or charge for you, so the liability cap can be compared with it.

amount.description: The amount, in whole units, for example "10000".

basis.description: Optional basis, for example "monthly payouts the service sends".

currency.description: The currency or asset, for example "USDC".

fields.description: The terms by topic. A field given here takes precedence over the text for that topic.

auto_renewal.description: Whether and how the service renews, and how to stop the renewal.

data_use.description: What the provider may do with your data, prompts and outputs.

indemnity.description: Who indemnifies whom, and for what.

liability_cap.description: The limitation of liability: the cap and what it excludes.

price.description: The price and how it is charged, for example "49 USD per month" or "0.002 USDC per request".

price_changes.description: How and with what notice the provider can change the price.

termination.description: How each side can end the service, and with what notice.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

text.description: The service terms as written, up to 64 KB.

name: wever_service-terms-check
title: Service terms check
